No experience necessary. Kids ages 7 - 11. Teens will learn the basics of rock climbing and practice their skills! No experience necessary. Ages 12 - 17. Let Campus Recreation help make your next party one to remember! Whether you want to glide on the ice at the Ice Arena, splash in the water at the CRCE Aquatic Center, or rock climb at the ARC Climbing Wall - there’s a party to meet your needs.
